Class SsJDBCArray

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.SsJDBCArray
All Implemented Interfaces:
Array
public class SsJDBCArray extends Object implements Array
Implementation of SQL array for SsList; most methods unsupported. Array data is not copied/safe.
